desc_en: This sleeveless mini dress redefines minimalist elegance with its straight-cut silhouette. Designed with a clean round neckline and a hidden zipper closure at the back, it delivers a sleek and sophisticated appearance. The garment falls around the mid-to-upper thigh, offering a fresh and refined allure. Crafted to provide a lightweight and comfortable wearing experience. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Este vestido mini sin mangas redefine la elegancia minimalista con su silueta de corte recto. Diseñado con un cuello redondo pulcro y un cierre de cremallera oculto en la espalda, ofrece una apariencia limpia y sofisticada. La prenda cae alrededor de la mitad del muslo, aportando un aire fresco y refinado. Confeccionado para ofrecer una experiencia de uso cómoda y ligera. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· 100% polyester
· Straight sleeveless cut
· Round neckline
· Hidden zipper at the back
· Hand wash or machine wash with maximum water temperature of 45ºC (113ºF)
· Made to order with worldwide shipping
